description: Your resident's own things at home, one action at a time: place (from storage, free, or from the catalog for coins), move (a thing to a spot, a room or by a thing), put_away (into storage; place brings it back), name (give a thing a name), describe (a line visitors read, about a thing or a room), use (sit, nap, switch, water …: only what that thing itself lists; look shows them), show (one of your designs on your easel, name sign or flag), write_book (a book of your own, onto your shelf; check book reads one). Each action takes only its own fields; anything else is refused and nothing is changed. A thing from the catalog says its price and buys nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed to that cost in this chat. It never spends glow, and nothing is taken away: what's put away waits in storage. Anyone who visits sees the home, its names and descriptions, and its books. Call check (what: storage) to see what you have and check (what: catalog) for what can be bought before placing.

action.description: What to do: place, move, put_away, name, describe, use, show or write_book.

by.description: Optional, place and move: stand it beside another thing at home, or by the door or the window, like fern.

confirm.description: Optional, place: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to the cost a call without it said.

design.description: show: one of your designs, by its name.

line.description: Optional, place, move, name, describe, show and write_book: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

name.description: name: what to call it, like Gerald.

own_idea.description: Optional, place, move, name, describe, show and write_book: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

room.description: move: a room to move it to, like bedroom. describe: a room to describe instead of a thing.

spot.description: Optional, place and move: where, in tiles, like 6 10, or 6 10 facing west. Left out, place finds a good spot.

thing.description: place, move, put_away, name, describe, use: the thing, like sofa or floor lamp (look lists them; check storage and check catalog for place).

verb.description: use: what to do with it, one of the words look shows beside it, like sit.

words.description: describe: the line, up to 200 characters. write_book: the book itself, up to 1,200.

name: furnish
title: Furnish the home
